title: Our Very First Picture Together In The Mall 📸✨
caption: Standing right next to you, taking our very first picture together in the mall. In a crowded place with so many people walking by, all I could focus on was your sweet smile in that purple dress, Bubly.
secretNote: I was secretly feeling butterflies standing this close to you for our very first photo, smiling inside knowing this was only the beginning of our story.

title: Our First Selfie 📸
caption: "Idhu just oru selfie illa... enakku romba special ahana oru memory. Un smile ah paakumbodhu enakku varra happiness ah words la solla mudiyathu. Indha photo va evlo naal paathalum, andha first moment feel mattum marakkave mudiyadhu. ❤️🥹"
secretNote: "Unakku theriyama naan unna neraya times rasichirukken... Un smile, un childishness, un chinna chinna reactions ellame enakku romba pidikkum. Maybe idhu love ah irukkalam... but one thing sure, nee enakku romba special. ❤️"

title: Our First Date – A Beautiful Beginning ❤️
caption: Andha poonga la neraya marangal, flowers irundhalum... en kannuku mattum nee dhaan romba azhaga therinja. Un kooda nadandha andha chinna walk, pesina andha chinna chinna vishayangal, un smile... ellame en manasula apdiye irukku. Andha naal oru normal day ah start aachu, aana en life la marakka mudiyadha memory ah maariduchu. ❤️🌷
secretNote: "Oru poonga, rendu hearts, countless feelings... idhu dhaan namma beautiful love story oda first chapter. ❤️"

title: A Journey With You ❤️🚌
caption: Bus journey la destination enga nu mukkiyam illa... nee en kooda irundha podhum, andha journey eh beautiful ah maaridum. Window vazhiya vandha kaathu, background la songs, un kooda pesina moments... ellame oru special feeling. Bus travel mudinjirukkalam, aana un kooda travel panna aasai mattum innum mudiyala. ❤️🫶
secretNote: "Bus stopped at the destination, but my heart wanted the journey with you to continue forever. ❤️"

title: You, Me & The Ocean – A Perfect Memory ❤️
caption: Kadal alai evlo azhaga vandhu pogutho, adha vida azhaga irundhuchu un kooda spend panna andha moments. Beach breeze, sunset, sand la nadandha footsteps, un smile... ellame oru beautiful dream maadhiri irundhuchu. Kadal ah paaka vandhen, aana en paarvai full ah unna dhaan thedichu. ❤️🌊
secretNote: "The waves may wash away our footprints, but they'll never wash away the memories we made together. ❤️🌊"

title: A Little Flower, A Million Feelings 🌸❤️
caption: Kovil la irundha andha azhagana moment... nee enakku poo vachcha andha second ah ennaala marakkave mudiyadhu. Andha poo un kaiyaala en thalaiyila vandhu serndhappo, adhu just oru flower ah theriyala... enakku romba special ahna feeling ah irundhuchu. Un smile, un kai, andha cute moment... ellame en heart la apdiye save aagiduchu. 🌸❤️
secretNote: "A flower placed by your hands became the most beautiful memory in my heart. 🌸 Forever special, forever you. ❤️"

title: Safest Place – In Your Arms ❤️🫂
caption: Kadal alai pakkathula irundhuchu, aana andha moment la naan vaanathula parakkura maadhiri feel pannen. Nee enna thookuna andha second, enakku ulagame konjam neram ninnuta maadhiri irundhuchu. Andha sirippu, andha closeness, andha happiness... photo la capture aanadhu oru pose mattum illa, en heart la forever save aana moment. ❤️🫶
secretNote: "The ocean was beautiful, the sunset was magical, but being in your arms was my favourite view. 🌊❤️"

title: Two Hands, One Heart – Our Love Story ❤️
caption: Rendu kai serndhu create panna oru chinna heart dhaan... aana adhukulla irukkura feelings romba perusu. ❤️ Un kaiyum en kaiyum serndha andha moment la, andha heart shape just oru pose ah theriyala... namma rendu peroda love ah represent panra maadhiri irundhuchu. Oru chinna gesture, aana lifetime remember panna koodiya beautiful memory. 🫶
secretNote: "Two hands, one heart, endless memories. No matter where life takes us, my heart will always find yours. ❤️🫶"

title: Shopping With My Favourite Person 🛍️❤️
caption: Shopping panna dhaan veliya vandhom... aana shopping vida un kooda spend panna time dhaan romba special ah irundhuchu. Nee dress select pannuradhu, enna paathu smile pannuradhu, chinna chinna arguments, random photos... ellame oru beautiful memory. Things vaanga pona day, aana memories neraya create pannitu vandhom. ❤️🛍️
secretNote: "We went shopping for things, but came back with memories that money can never buy. ❤️🛍️"

title: Lunch With My Favourite Person ❤️🥰
caption: Lunch saapida dhaan vandhom... aana food vida un kooda spend panna andha time dhaan enakku romba special. Unakku pudicha food, enakku pudicha food, konjam sharing, konjam teasing, neraya smiles... andha lunch time oru beautiful memory ah maariduchu. Food taste marandhaalum, un kooda saapitta andha moment mattum marakka mudiyadhu. ❤️🍕
secretNote: "Good food fills my stomach, but your company fills my heart. ❤️🍽️"

title: College Days With You – Forever Special ❤️
caption: College ku daily vandhaalum, unna paakura andha moments mattum daily special dhaan. Class, breaks, corridors, canteen, random meetings... idhellam normal college moments ah irundhaalum, nee irundhadhunaala beautiful memories ah maariduchu. Friends ellarum irundhaalum, en kannu mattum unna dhaan thedum. College life mudinjidalam, aana un kooda create panna memories mattum endrum mudiyadhu. ❤️🎓
secretNote: "College gave me many memories, but you became my favourite chapter. ❤️📖"

title: Your Hand in Mine – My Favourite Feeling ❤️
caption: Un kaiya pudicha andha oru moment... words la describe panna mudiyadha oru feeling. Ulagathula evlo per irundhaalum, andha moment la enakku un kai mattum dhaan mukkiyam ah therinjuchu. Un kaiya pudichittu nadakkumbodhu, destination enga nu kooda yosikkala... indha journey ippadiye continue aaganum nu mattum dhaan thonuchu. ❤️🫂
secretNote: "I don't need the whole world in my hands; just your hand in mine, forever. ❤️🤝"

title: My Favourite Face, My Favourite Frame ❤️
caption: Gallery la thousands of photos irukkalam... aana un kooda edutha indha selfie ku mattum oru special place irukku. Camera la capture aanadhu namma faces dhaan, aana en heart la capture aanadhu andha moment oda happiness. Un smile pakkathula irukkumbodhu, en smile automatic ah vandhudum. Oru simple selfie, aana enakku lifetime favourite memory. ❤️🫶
secretNote: "Some pictures capture moments, but our selfies capture a little piece of my heart. ❤️📸"

title: A Little World of Our Own – You & Me ❤️
caption: Park la neraya flowers, trees, beautiful views irundhaalum... enakku andha naaloda best view nee dhaan. Un kooda nadandhadhu, bench la ukkandhu pesinadhu, reason illama sirichadhu, chinna chinna moments enjoy pannadhu... ellame romba special. Andha park oru normal place ah irundhirukkalam, aana nee kooda irundhadhunaala en favourite memory spot ah maariduchu. ❤️🌷
secretNote: "The park was full of beautiful flowers, but my favourite beauty was sitting right beside me. 🌸❤️"

title: Recreating Our First Memory – Same Us, Same Love ❤️
caption: First time edutha andha photo va marubadiyum recreate pannumbodhu, pazhaya memories ellam thirumba vandha maadhiri irundhuchu. Appo irundha same smile, same happiness, same person... aana ippo memories mattum innum adhigam. First photo la start aana namma story, indha recreation la innum beautiful ah continue aagudhu. ❤️🫶
secretNote: "Same place, same pose, same two hearts… just a little more love than before. ❤️📸"
